RFO - FAR 6.103-2, Unusual and compelling urgency. Authority: 41 U.S.C. 3304(a)(2). Justifications citing RFO - FAR 6.103-2 must explain how the agency’s need for the supplies or services is of such an unusual and compelling urgency that the Government would be seriously injured unless the agency is permitted to limit the number of sources from which it solicits bids or proposals. Include a discussion of the required delivery schedule and lead-time involved. Describe the unusual or compelling urgency and provide an explanation of how Government use of conventional procurement procedures would result in an unacceptable delay to the Government. Provide data, estimated cost, or other rationale as to the extent and nature of harm to the Government that would result from following competitive procedures. Explain the Period of Performance (PoP) requested and why that PoP is needed to support the Urgent and Compelling requirement, as well as what the agency is doing to secure a competitive action by the end of the urgent need and PoP stated. Contract actions citing RFO - FAR 6.103-2 as the authority for issuing non-competitive work may not exceed one year, including all options, unless the SPE [or the SPE’s designee] determines that exceptional circumstances apply and makes this recommendation to, and is approved by, the head of the agency. c.
